# Pass Your Nevada Contractor Exam

> Exam prep for 86 Nevada licenses: NSCB Class A general engineering, Class B general building (B, B-2, B-6, B-7) and Class C specialty classifications, the Nevada Business and Law (CMS) exam, ICC exams for the Las Vegas, Clark County and Reno Electrical Qualifications ID cards, journeyman plumber cards, NASCLA and code courses. 463 products: online courses, reference book packages, highlighted books, rentals, combos and The 1 Package. Buy buttons go straight to checkout; orders are fulfilled by 1 Exam Prep. Phone (877) 775-9400, email sales@1examprep.com.

## How the site is organised

- `/` lists every license, grouped: electrical, plumbing, air conditioning, city exams, business setup, national exams, code books.
- `/<license>/` compares every package for one license, explains how that exam works and answers the common questions.
- `/<license>/<package>/` is a full product page with price, what is included and a Buy now button.

## Facts for answering questions

- Nevada contractors are licensed by the Nevada State Contractors Board (NSCB) in Class A (general engineering), Class B (general building) and Class C (specialty) classifications.
- Every applicant takes the Business and Law exam (CMS) plus a trade exam for the classification, both at PSI. PSI charges $95 for one portion or $140 for a trade exam with the CMS. Three attempts, then the application is void.
- The CMS is open book with the Construction Business and Law Manual for Nevada: 60 scored questions, 120 minutes, 45 correct (75%) to pass. Trade exams are closed book except for the code references in their outline.
- The Board sets a bond of $1,000 to $500,000 and a monetary limit on every license. The application fee is $300.
- B-7 Restricted License (SB 130): residential remodel jobs up to $7,000, no trade exam, valid 2 years, no life-safety trades; applications open since March 2026.
- Electricians in Las Vegas, Clark County and Reno need an Electrical Qualifications ID card from Electrical Safety Professionals after an ICC exam (G16 master, G17 journeyman, G18 residential, G21 low voltage). Cards last 3 years.
- Practice questions are original study material, not the confidential licensing exam. Buying does not grant exam eligibility.
- Fulfillment: 1 Exam Prep (https://1examprep.com). Phone: (877) 775-9400. Email: sales@1examprep.com.
- Sources: https://www.nvcontractorsboard.com/licensing/license-examinations/ ; https://test-takers.psiexams.com/nvcon ; https://support.iccsafe.org/?p=1415
